title: Multimodal stimulation screens reveal unique and shared genes limiting T cell fitness
model: Primary OT-I/Cas9 mouse CD8 T cells, Brie genome-wide knockout library
contrast: Intense CD3 stimulation vs pre-reactivation, acute stimulation vs pre-reactivation, chronic tumour co-culture vs resting (1 vs 1 each; replicates summed by the authors)
paper_calls: 54 / 64 / 9 enriched genes at FDR 0.10 (intense / acute / chronic)
named_hits: Trp53, Eif4g2 (Dap5) and Icam1 at FDR 0.10 in intense and acute; Ctbp1 (chronic) FDR 0.47
verdict: BARCS reproduces the authors' intense and acute rankings (40-45 of the top 50 shared) and calls Trp53, Dap5 and Icam1 strongly; in the bottlenecked chronic screen it calls Dap5 and Trp53 but, like MAGeCK, not Ctbp1, and its depletion lists are screening-level because replicates were summed before deposit.
